headline: Stocks to Watch: Shilpa Medicare, Tega Industries, NIBE
summary: Shilpa Medicare surges on CDSCO nod; Tega Industries raises funds. NIBE signs naval MoU. Check other stocks in focus today.

headline: Court rules in GMR Airports' favour on AERA tariff order
summary: A court has ruled in favour of GMR Airports on its appeal against an AERA tariff order concerning Indira Gandhi International Airport.

headline: Acme Solar launches Acme Greentech Twenty Nine unit
summary: Acme Solar Holdings launched a new subsidiary, Acme Greentech Twenty Nine, focused on power generation and renewable energy projects.

headline: Premier Energies commissions 7 GW solar cell plant
summary: Premier Energies commissions a 7 GW N-type TOPCon solar cell facility in Andhra Pradesh, raising total capacity to 10.6 GW. The ₹3,293 crore project positions the firm as India's largest cell manufacturer.

headline: Biocon's Pebrilzo gets EMA CHMP positive opinion
summary: Biocon Limited announced that the EMA's CHMP issued a positive opinion for its Pertuzumab biosimilar, Pebrilzo. This marks the first biosimilar approved under the new tailored clinical approach.

headline: Complete Sports wins Rs 24 crore order for indoor go-karting facility
summary: Confirmed Rs 24 crore work order from a large South India-based company for India's first indoor go-karting facility. No prior order history available; order equals 41.4% of latest quarterly revenue.

headline: JLR in talks with global banks for $1.3 billion loan
summary: Jaguar Land Rover has initiated discussions with global banks to secure a $1.3 billion loan over a five-year term, according to reports.

headline: Titan open to acquiring smaller watch brands
summary: Titan has expressed openness to acquiring smaller watch brands, signalling a potential inorganic growth strategy in the watches segment.

headline: NLC India targets 104.35 Mtpa mining, 10+ GW renewables
summary: NLC India plans to scale mining capacity to 104.35 Mtpa and renewable energy to over 10 GW by 2030, backed by a ₹1.17 lakh crore expansion programme.

headline: Adani Power begins ₹48,000 crore power project in Assam
summary: Adani Power has commenced a ₹48,000 crore power project in Assam, marking a significant infrastructure development in the region's energy sector.

headline: Auto stocks eye festive demand amid supply constraints
summary: Auto stocks are looking to festive season demand for a boost, but a high base effect and supply-side constraints may limit sales growth, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Montra targets ₹9,600 crore revenue by 2030
summary: Montra, the commercial EV brand under Tube Investments, targets ₹9,600 crore in revenue by 2030, with electric trucks expected to drive 70% of that growth ambition.

headline: Mini Diamonds wins Rs 14.5 crore order from Aura Diamond
summary: Mini Diamonds secures Rs 14.5 crore work order for natural diamonds. Book-to-bill is 0.09x. Order inflow decelerated in Q2FY27. Low OPM and high leverage remain key risks.

headline: GP Petroleums accepts Harshavardhan Sinha resignation
summary: GP Petroleums Ltd accepted the resignation of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director Harshavardhan Sinha effective September 19, 2026. He cited UK residence requirements as the reason.

headline: Magellanic Cloud secures Rs 44.6 lakh order from Nayara Energy
summary: Magellanic Cloud wins Rs 44.6 lakh contract for AI-powered ANPR and video analytics at Nayara Energy outlets. This adds to its Rs 333.35 crore order book across 41 deals in last 3 quarters.

headline: Escorts Kubota appoints Manish Sharma as President
summary: Escorts Kubota Limited has appointed Manish Sharma as President-Agri Business effective September 21, 2026. Sharma brings over 30 years of experience in manufacturing and technology to lead the domestic and international agri business units.

headline: Eris Lifesciences appoints Akhil Awasthi as director
summary: Eris Lifesciences has appointed investment veteran Akhil Awasthi as an additional independent director for a five-year term effective September 26, 2026.

headline: Lenskart Solutions shares flag large trade on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 3,52,68,708 shares of Lenskart Solutions changing hands on NSE at ₹687.95, with a combined value of ₹2,426.31 crore.

headline: Garment Mantra wins Rs 10.37 cr export order from Zaara Overseas
summary: Garment Mantra Lifestyle secures Rs 10.37 crore export order for fabrics. Adds to Rs 8.28 crore backlog. Book-to-bill remains low at 0.03x.

headline: Patanjali Foods flags weak rural demand, margin pressure
summary: Patanjali Foods highlights weak rural demand and sunflower oil sales, with poor monsoon and 90% margin pressure potentially leading to lower guidance after Q2.

headline: Texmaco Rail sets 2030 revenue, margin targets
summary: Texmaco Rail aims to double revenue and hit mid-teen EBITDA margins by 2030. The firm expects 15-20% revenue growth in coming years. Defence segment could reach ₹2,500-3,000 crore in 2-3 years.

headline: Shyam Metalics shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~1,327,131 shares of Shyam Metalics & Energy changing hands on NSE at ₹1,078.30, with a combined value of ₹143.10 crore.

headline: ZF CVCS India posts record FY26 revenue, margin expansion
summary: ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India reported a record FY26 financial performance with revenue rising 9.2% to ₹4,302 crore and net profit up 12% to ₹517 crore.

headline: Bharti Airtel shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 7,43,826 Bharti Airtel shares changing hands at ₹1,842.50 on NSE, with a combined value of ₹137.05 crore.

headline: Kaynes Technology sees strong customer inquiries
summary: Kaynes Technology India reports receiving significant inquiries from customers and anticipates achieving 90% capacity utilisation soon.
